Fethiye Pickup Zones

Free collection from all Fethiye area accommodations:

Fethiye Center

All hotels, hostels & Airbnbs. 08:00 or 14:00 pickup.

Çalış Beach

Beachfront hotels along the 4km strip.

Hisarönü / Ovacık

Hillside resort villages between Fethiye and Ölüdeniz.

Ölüdeniz

Blue Lagoon beachfront. Closest to the landing zone.
